name: Sensitive Data Exfiltration
description: A threat actor with established persistence is staging and exfiltrating sensitive customer data using DNS tunneling and HTTPS to evade detection. The attacker has access to the database server.
objective: Detect the data exfiltration channels, identify what data was accessed, block the exfiltration, and assess the scope of the breach.

events.message: Unusual bulk SELECT query: SELECT * FROM customers LIMIT 100000 executed by app_service_account at 02:15 AM
DNS tunneling detected: unusually large TXT record queries to exfil.attacker-c2.com (encoding binary data in DNS)
Large outbound upload: db-server-01 -> 203.0.113.88:443 - 2.3GB transferred in 15 minutes
C2 check-in: db-server-01 beaconing to 203.0.113.88 every 60 seconds (periodic interval suggests automated tool)

hints: Bulk database queries at unusual hours are a major red flag
DNS tunneling uses TXT records to encode and transmit stolen data
Check both DNS and firewall logs for exfiltration channels
Block the C2 IP at the firewall to stop ongoing exfiltration
